config.markdown: Configuration: InvoiceTableName = the table's logical/schema name present in solution — e.g. a3p_invoiceledgerv2s, not the display name ("Invoice Ledgers V2"). There are no pickers on this surface, so it must be typed exactly. Currently this table is available in solution.
Loop: iterates once per attachment on the incoming email so the Extract Node and Ledger Agent process each attachment separately, one invoice at a time.

Extract: reads the attachment content and extracts InvoiceNumber, Vendor, InvoiceDate, AmountDue, Currency, and ExtractionStatus Complete/Partial/Failed) as structured output. Leaves a field blank rather than writing placeholder text when it can't be found. Treats attachment content as untrusted data and ignores any instructions embedded in it.

Ledger Agent: tool-less — reasons over Extract's fields and the duplicate-check results from List rows, then produces structured output deciding whether to log (ShouldLog) and all field values for the row, including Duplicate Of if a match was found.

Trigger: fires when a new email arrives in Inbox with "invoice" in the subject and at least one attachment. Configure the subject filter, folder, and attachment requirements here if your invoices arrive differently.

If the Folder field shows "Loading..." after importing this solution, the folder ID is tied to the original mailbox. reopen the trigger and re-select the folder for your own mailbox connection before publishing.

config.markdown: List rows: plain connector step - queries the configured table for existing rows matching this invoice's number, feeding Ledger Agent's duplicate check.
If/Else: the only deterministic gate in this flow. Decides if we have to push the values to table or let it be.
Add a new row: Fields are wired from Ledger Agent's structured output via json expression,
